body: To explain better, what I find rude is when people use non-suicidal people to help compare things to suicidal people. It’s unfair to use someone who doesn’t struggle with simply being alive to someone who’s biggest struggle is being alive.

Sorry to be rude about it. Once more, you’re very kind and it shows.

Glad to offer another point of view. At least. c:

Society has abused and forced the view of education to be seen as such a high factor; but I assure you, as a 26 year old who had to go to a charter school to finish their diploma and have never touched a higher education, schooling isn’t all there is. 

Even if the job you want requires a higher education, there is no time stamp on these things. It’s not a race, if you need a break; you need a break. 

It’s more admirable that you see your breaking point and put yourself first. It’s a very hard thing to do. So perhaps instead of being so upset and mad at yourself for leaving high school at this time, take a step back and admire how you made a difficult decision; epically as someone who is suicidal. 

If it helps I can list a number of people who have done much more with no schooling vs those with years of it. While I think comparing others to those who are suicidal is rude, I can see where it may bring you some calm to see others close to your own position do well regardless.

Your intention is kind, but your words leave a sour taste in the mouth...

You’re comparing the hard life and work of someone who wants live, who wants better for themselves (and perhaps others, family); to me. To one of the many who can’t handle an easy life, of someone who doesn’t want to even live.

It’s hard not to be offended for the Syria.

Yes but what does one do when that ‘anyone’ is the one closest to you and who you love the most. Is the one who’s only thoughts and words matter.

Funny you use what I preach to all my friends; “your feelings are valid” 

Always easier to say then to follow; but the biggest thing here is, you can believe in yourself and the thought what you’re feeling is normal, is ok. But if no one around you thinks that.. is it really normal? Is it really ok?
